method: Per-replay, per-turn: for every winner-owned planet, compute whether the nearest enemy-owned planet's straight line is blocked by the sun. Aggregate shielded-turn count per planet. Spearman correlation of shielded-fraction vs survived-to-end (per replay).

falsification_gate.description: Mean Spearman correlation >=0.2 between shielded-turn fraction and planet survival, across top-10 games.

headline_findings: Sun-shadow signal is essentially zero: mean Spearman 0.025, median is even slightly negative.
Planets are shielded by the sun on only 6.1% of owned-turns on average. The sun's coverage is too small for shielding to be a significant strategic factor over a 500-turn game.
Planet survival rate (89.2%) is so high in top-10 wins that there is little variance to correlate with anything.
Decision: do NOT add a sun-shielded-turn bonus to the v7 value head. `lib/geometry.path_clears_sun` remains correct for short-term path planning but should not influence target priority.
downstream_uses: Experiment Option 3 (sun-shadow valuation bonus) is KILLED. No further work on this axis.
